path: Production ownsSourceDocumentsPresentation calls requireMounted, which requires surface.isForegroundMounted.

Exact AnyNativeEditor isForegroundMounted reads windowScene.activationState == .foregroundActive. Its viewWillDisappear retires the document only for removal/dismissal; exact AnyNativeDocumentView has no scenePhase-driven retirement.
A temporarily inactive scene can retain the same mounted document and Properties generation while isOwnerCurrent is false.

When the pending read settles or its Task reaches its initial guard, defer requires owns(captured) AND isOwnerCurrent, so it skips clearing request/task/isLoading and skips the reservation completion callback.
Foreground restoration does not itself retire that unchanged generation; a subsequent model.load rejects because request is still non-nil.
